# jackops makeup meeting
Date: 2026-10-08 | Duration: 63.58000183105469m

## Summary
The discussion covered testing Fireflies for transcript integration while preferring Fathom for note quality, plus the need for style guides governing AI-generated and human blog writing. Website work included sharing a raw Notion board, documenting CMS specifications for blog, event, and podcast pages, and potentially rebuilding the site because of CMS complexity and inconsistent AI-generated content. Analytics problems may relate to cookies and the HubSpot switch, while homepage, pricing, and documentation journeys have low engagement and lack signup links. Content priorities include increasing blog volume, adding human perspectives from marketing, sales, and engineering, creating solution-aware playbooks and checklists, and later pursuing PR, third-party placements, podcast guests, and ghostwritten positioning articles. Karen Henke’s influence, Jack Virag’s advocacy, Yousef’s website support, expectations around collaboration, and the marketing team’s development were also discussed.

## Keywords
Growth Book, Website Redesign, Content Strategy, AI Writing, Analytics, Customer Journey, Marketing
